default.description: Main window: app commands are not ACL-gated (verified: attach worked with an empty capability set), but PLUGIN commands are — the webview's notification calls fail silently without the grants below. The three are named one at a time rather than taken as notification:default, which is all 16 of the plugin's permissions; src/capabilities.test.ts fails if the set stops matching what src/notify.ts actually calls, in either direction.
